title: Edit on a tier's matrix row opens the grid in edit at that tier
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Click Edit on matrix A's row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Tier A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • Matrix A's page opens with its grid already in edit (Cancel and Save show).
  • Tier A's column is in view.
  • The breadcrumb reads Settings › Pricing › Tiers › tier A's name › matrix A's name.
